newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia broker Dadas banned from trading - bourse.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia broker Dadas banned from trading - bourse.

text.p: Slovenian brokerage Dadas has been banned from trading on the Ljubljana bourse due to alleged illegal trading practices, the bourse said on Tuesday.

The parent company, financial consultancy Dadas, has been facing serious problems since March when the bourse's watchdog -- the Securities Market Agency -- pushed to prohibit both Dadas' broking arm and its mutual fund from trading due to alleged trading irregularities.
Deputy chief executive of the watchdog, Nina Plavsak, confirmed the brokerage has been banned for good.
Since March, shares of financial consultancy Dadas, which are listed on the main section of the Ljubljana bourse, have plunged more than 95 percent.
On Tuesday alone, Dadas dropped 37.7 percent to 11,500 tolars. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
